resources.string: Klack Keyboard is a keyboard. Android does not let any app hear what you type in other keyboards, so Klack has to be the keyboard you type on. Two steps:
Opens the system “On-screen keyboard” list. Switch on Klack Keyboard and accept the standard warning.
Opens the keyboard picker. Choose Klack Keyboard. You can switch back any time with the keyboard icon in the navigation bar.
Status: enabled, but another keyboard is selected
Also follows your phone’s media volume.
Tap here and type to try it
